commands.cmd:
D=$(mktemp -d) && printf '%s' '{"type":"object","properties":{"layer_count":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["layer_count"],"additionalProperties":false}' > "$D/s1.json" && printf '%s' '{"type":"object","properties":{"first_layer":{"type":"string"}},"required":["first_layer"],"additionalProperties":false}' > "$D/s2.json" && timeout 900 codex exec --json --output-schema "$D/s1.json" -o "$D/l1.json" -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort=max --sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check "Open catalogs/landscape/foundation.json with your own shell tools and count the entries of its top-level layers array. Return the count as layer_count." < /dev/null > "$D/e1.jsonl" 2> "$D/x1" && tid=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(next(json.loads(l)['thread_id'] for l in open(sys.argv[1]) if l.strip() and json.loads(l).get('type')=='thread.started'))" "$D/e1.jsonl") && timeout 900 codex exec resume "$tid" -c sandbox_mode=read-only --json --output-schema "$D/s2.json" -o "$D/l2.json" -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort=max --skip-git-repo-check "In that same layers array, return the layer_id of the first entry as first_layer." < /dev/null > "$D/e2.jsonl" 2> "$D/x2" && python3 -c "
import json, sys
D = sys.argv[1]
def events(p): return [json.loads(l) for l in open(p) if l.strip()]
e1, e2 = events(D + '/e1.jsonl'), events(D + '/e2.jsonl')
layers = json.load(open('catalogs/landscape/foundation.json'))['layers']
tid = next(e['thread_id'] for e in e1 if e.get('type') == 'thread.started')
items1 = [e['item']['type'] for e in e1 if e.get('type') == 'item.completed']
items2 = [e['item']['type'] for e in e2 if e.get('type') == 'item.completed']
tid2 = [e.get('thread_id') for e in e2 if e.get('type') == 'thread.started']
l1, l2 = json.load(open(D + '/l1.json')), json.load(open(D + '/l2.json'))
lim = any('usage limit' in open(D + '/' + x).read().lower() for x in ('x1', 'x2'))
ok = (not lim and 'command_execution' in items1 and any(e.get('type') == 'turn.completed' for e in e1)
      and l1 == {'layer_count': len(layers)} and l2 == {'first_layer': layers[0]['layer_id']}
      and any(e.get('type') == 'turn.completed' for e in e2) and tid2 == [tid])
print('CODEX_SDK_SURFACES_VERIFIED' if ok else 'CODEX_SDK_SURFACES_FAILED', '| codex', sys.argv[2], '| same thread resumed:', tid2 == [tid])
print('turn1 json events', sorted(dict.fromkeys(e.get('type') for e in e1)), 'items', sorted(dict.fromkeys(items1)), 'schema out', l1, 'vs python', len(layers))
print('turn2 exec resume items', sorted(dict.fromkeys(items2)), 'schema out', l2, 'vs python', layers[0]['layer_id'])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
" "$D" "$(codex --version | awk '{print $2}')"
